effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USDT from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints gUSDTq vault shares to `onBehalf`. The number of shares comes from previewDeposit after accrueInterest.
Needs an existing USDT allowance to the vault. No new approval is set.
formats.shown: Deposit 1 USDT, with gUSDTq shares going to onBehalf (0x…dEaD in the test case).

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is computed on chain and not shown, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The share price comes from storage after accrueInterest. The calldata has no min-shares parameter.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The share recipient and ticker are already shown.

cases.notes: 1 USDT out is shown right. The 1e18 gUSDTq went to 0xdEaD (not the signer), and the screen says so in 'Send shares to'. The reader saw that correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns gUSDTq shares from `onBehalf`. The amount comes from previewWithdraw(assets) and is rounded up.
When the caller is not `onBehalf`, it spends that many shares of the share allowance onBehalf gave the caller.
Sends exactly `assets` USDT from the vault to `receiver`.
May pull liquidity from the liquidity adapter first. That does not change the signer's amounts.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 10 USDT to the receiver, with the Owner whose position pays for it.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of gUSDTq shares burned from the Owner is computed on chain and never shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)`, and exit calls `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. In case 1 the signer lost 9.996788749140481981 gUSDTq, and the screen shows no share amount. The reader wrote 'Nothing is shown leaving my wallet'.
findings.fix: No amount can be shown. The intent could say 'Withdraw {assets} by burning gUSDTq shares of {onBehalf}' so the share burn is explicit.

cases.notes: 10 USDT in is shown right. The gUSDTq burn has no amount on screen; the reader only guessed that their position shrinks by about 10 USDT.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: When the caller is not `onBehalf`, it spends `shares` of the share allowance onBehalf gave the caller.
Sends USDT from the vault to `receiver`. The amount comes from previewRedeem(shares), and the calldata sets no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 118989.947… gUSDTq to the receiver, with the Owner shown. The asset and amount received are not shown.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT received is computed from the share price, and no amount or minimum can be shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. In case 1 the signer received 119057.847309 USDT, and no field shows it.
findings.fix: None for the amount. The calldata has no minAssets.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDT as the asset received, though it is a known constant.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem has intent 'Redeem' and interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}'. metadata.constants.underlyingTicker 'USDT' is not used. The case 2 reader was 'unsure: Which token is paid out (USDT is only inferred from the name)'.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Redeem gUSDTq for USDT' / 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDT to {#.receiver}', or add a constant field 'Receive' = $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker.

cases.notes: The gUSDTq burned is shown right (18 decimals through @.to). The USDT received (119057.847309) has no asset or amount on screen; the reader guessed USDT and did not know the amount.
